_comment: Lighthouse CI config: enforces the performance budgets declared in references/LANDING-CINEMATIC.md section 5 on LANDING pages (the doctrine's subject). Game pages (index, battle, cards, market) are excluded for now: their window load event never fires (dangling asset requests, same root cause as the tavern-tales Backstop hang) and Lighthouse requires load. Fix the pages, then add them here. INP is field-only, so total-blocking-time stands in as the lab proxy. Run locally: npm run lh (server on :3000). CI: ci/page-quality.yml.
